text:
Maya L.: Quick preflight question — we're planning a default-model update on /v1/generate to `redwood-llama-v2` next week. Before I open the PR: what's the compatibility checklist and recommended deprecation window?
Kevin H.: good call. Are we changing response shape or just model weights/behavior?
Maya L.: just model weights/behavior. No schema changes. But outputs might be different (tokens, stop behavior) — risk of downstream score drift.
Sophia Q.: then we should treat this as a behavioral change not a contract change. Steps: (1) add Accept-Model header support, (2) ensure server fallback to pinned model, (3) update SDK default pinning docs, (4) notify customers + 60 day deprec window.
Tom S.: SDK side: we have an `auto_pin` toggle in python/js SDKs. We can flip to keep existing default pinned for 45 days and then change. Need migration helper in SDK.
Nina P.: I'm +1 for customer comms. Suggest a phased email + console banner + changelog entry. I'd prefer 90 days if possible.
Kevin H.: can we quantify impact? Sophia — can your team run an eval set (sampled production prompts) to compute quality delta and token cost delta?
Sophia Q.: yes, we can run eval. I'll post results by EOD tomorrow. If delta > 5% AP loss we delay.
Maya L.: also need a rollout plan for Dedicated tenants — do we allow them opt-in to new default or we keep pinned until they request change?
Kevin H.: Dedicated: keep pinned until customer requests or until commit window (contractually agreed). Add note in rollout playbook.
Tom S.: quick SDK PR checklist: update README, add migration guide snippet `client.accept_model = 'redwood-llama-v2'`, add unit that verifies header gets sent.
Maya L.: example header we propose:
```
Accept-Model: "redwood-llama-v2, redwood-llama-v1;q=0.9"
```
This allows client-side negotiation.
Kevin H.: love the header. Add server-side precedence: explicit model param > Accept-Model > default server selection.
Sophia Q.: also add automated compatibility tests: replay 1k recorded requests, compare tokenization and top-K outputs, flag regressions.
Maya L.: who's owning the rollout doc + customer comms?
Nina P.: I'll own comms. Kevin — can you own the rollout doc with Sophia and Tom as SMEs?
Kevin H.: yep, I'll draft the doc today and link PR.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout to staging cluster at 2026-03-19T02:00Z (canary=10%).
Tom S.: pinging @Kevin for SDK PR review when ready.
Kevin H.: will review. Also add a short blurb in release notes template: "behavioral model swap — not a schema change; check your evaluation harness." :loudspeaker:
Maya L.: thanks all — will wait for Sophia's eval and Kevin's doc before opening default-change PR. :thumbsup:
